uncertainObservations: I cannot reliably count the blades cradled against the shoulder. Two round pommels are clearly and separately resolvable at the top, and I can trace two distinct crossguards and at least two descending blade faces — but the figure's forearm crosses the bundle and there is a further hilt-like shape behind the arm that may be a third blade or may be the edge of one already counted. I record that sub-count as null; it is two or three.
Because of that, the total number of blades in the image is also not something I will commit to — the individually confident sub-counts are: one in the lowered hand, two on the ground.
The two ground blades are partly obscured by grass and the lower one runs close to the border; a third, fully hidden blade in the grass cannot be ruled out, though I see no evidence of one.
The middle-ground figure's sex, and whether either background figure carries anything, cannot be determined at that scale.
The bottom border panel is blank in the artwork itself (not a mask) and carries no readable text.
